notes: New: TOD Sync, a tool that shows what the automatic time-of-day sync did and why. New: switches to stop Cut Valet touching your Resolve project, a chosen truth-axis camera, and a sync scope cap. Frame rates: Cut Valet now warns when your footage and timeline rates disagree, and cuts land where they were planned on mismatched-rate footage. Time Sync is now Timecode Slate. A usage-data opt-out that actually stops the bytes. Fixes: resyncing with the wrong Resolve project open is one instruction instead of 86 errors; a backup drive that refuses writes says so once and how to fix it; three Settings actions and Apple Silicon describing no longer crash; clips are no longer imported twice; and a long list of truthful-reporting fixes.
